hypothesis: Higher recent Binance perpetual premium-index ranks predict higher next-day cross-sectional returns among liquid assets.
signal: Lagged 5-day mean premium_index_close; neighboring preregistered lookbacks 3 and 7 days.
universe: Point-in-time assets with 30 days of continuous data; top 80 percent by lagged trailing 30-day close*volume.
rebalance: Daily at 01:00 UTC using information available by 00:00 UTC.
construction: Equal-weight high-minus-low terciles with 0.5 gross exposure per side.
development_gate: mean rank IC >= 0.02, HAC p < 0.05, positive high-minus-low next-day return
limitations: Perpetual premium index is a proxy rather than the calendar-futures basis in the source; historical funding cashflows are unavailable.
